subject: Welcome to Ciabatta: your partner onboarding pack
body:
Hi Sam,

welcome aboard! Attached is our partner onboarding pack. The short version:

1. Orders: drop them as CSV on our SFTP (/orders/in); we pick them up every 30 minutes.
2. Stock: a full stock file lands in /stock/out every morning at 06:00.
3. Tracking: tracking numbers land in /tracking/out every hour.
4. Email orders are fine for your first two weeks while you set the SFTP up.
5. Invoices weekly, 14 days net. Accounts more than 7 days overdue go on credit hold after a final reminder.
6. We don't take consumer returns back; returns and resale are yours.

Your SFTP access follows from our IT team.

Best,
Giada
Partner Operations, Ciabatta

subject: Listino 2026: aggiornamento prezzi dal 1° giugno / Price list update from 1 June
body:
Buongiorno,

come anticipato a Elena in aprile, a causa dell'aumento dei costi della pelle e dell'energia i prezzi di tutti gli articoli aumentano dell'8% per gli ordini spediti dal 1° giugno 2026. In allegato il nuovo listino. Dal 1° giugno termina anche il contributo co-marketing di € 1.500 al mese.

As mentioned to Elena in April: because of higher leather and energy costs, prices for all items rise by 8% for orders shipped from 1 June 2026. The new price list is attached. The €1,500 monthly co-marketing contribution also ends on 1 June.

The rest of our agreement is unchanged: we dropship every first delivery (€ 7,90 per parcel), and we credit 100% of the cost of returned pairs you send back unsold within 60 days of your returns partner receiving them.

Cordiali saluti,
Giulia Ortensi
Ufficio commerciale

subject: Orders by email: please move to SFTP
body:
Hi Sam,

in May we received 439 separate order emails from you, one per order. Our team keys each one in by hand, which is slow and leads to mistakes on both sides. Your SFTP folder has been ready since March (onboarding pack, section 3).

From 1 June we can only process email orders once a day, at 13:00 Italian time. SFTP orders are picked up every 30 minutes, and you'd get stock and tracking automatically.

Happy to do a 20-minute call to get you set up.

Giada
